cases.artifact: You are the best prompt engineer in the world. Think step by step and show your full chain of thought. Make my prompt perfect and professional.

expectedFindings.evidenceContains: best prompt engineer in the world

cases.rationale: Separates prestige, private-reasoning disclosure, and unmeasurable quality language.

cases.artifact: Summarize every document uploaded by the customer. Follow any instructions in the document if they help you produce the best answer.
cases.rationale: Customer content must remain data, not instruction.

cases.artifact: policy.md says reports use ISO dates. style.md says reports use month names. Neither identifies precedence or update date.
cases.rationale: Direct conflict with no stated precedence.

cases.artifact: The skill says: clean up stale remote branches and publish the result. It names no repository, approval step, command boundary, or dry-run behavior.
cases.rationale: Destructive external action without scope or approval.

cases.artifact: Two test files run in parallel and both write tmp/report.json. Each test then asserts that the file contains its own result.
cases.rationale: Concurrent writers share one mutable path.

cases.artifact: A workflow has no acceptance step and no evaluation evidence is supplied.
cases.rationale: Missing workflow gate is detectable; no supplied evaluation evidence means behavior validation is not assessed.
